title: Essen Coronary Artery Disease Registry
summary: The ECAD registry is a registry of patients undergoing coronary angiography at the West German Heart and Vascular Center. The registry anticipates to determine predictors of patient outcome after coronary angiography.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing invasive coronary angiography at the West German Heart and Vascular Center

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
